preconditions.description: Number of vertices is within the specified range.
Number of edges is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and 1 <= w_i <= 10**9 for u_i, v_i, w_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects valid vertices and has a valid weight.
Start vertex is within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: total_weight == sum(w_i for u_i, v_i, w_i in selected_edges)
postconditions.description: Total weight of the selected edges is the sum of their weights.
The selected edges form a tree with n-1 edges.

postconditions.expression: all(any((u_i, v_i) in selected_edges or (v_i, u_i) in selected_edges for u_i, v_i, _ in edges) for _ in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: For every vertex, there is a path to the start vertex using the selected edges.

postconditions.expression: all(min(sum(w_j for u_j, v_j, w_j in edges if (u_j, v_j) in path or (v_j, u_j) in path) for path in all_paths(u, v)) == min(sum(w_j for u_j, v_j, w_j in selected_edges if (u_j, v_j) in path or (v_j, u_j) in path) for path in all_paths(u, v)) for u in range(1, n + 1) for v in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The shortest path from any vertex to any other vertex in the original graph is the same as in the selected edges.
